new_hire_deadline_text: within six months of beginning employment
provider_approval_type: standardized curriculum by Department of Human Services
required_topics: identifying individuals at risk for human trafficking
difference between labor and sex trafficking in relation to lodging establishments, restaurants, and truck stops
employee roles in reporting and responding to human trafficking incidents
notes: Training must be completed within six months of employment and every two years thereafter.
Employers can use their own program or the one provided by the Department of Human Services.
